senses.sense_definition: To adapt a wild animal or plant to live in close association with humans.

examples.text: Humans began to <w>domesticate</w> wolves thousands of years ago.

target_lang_translations.zh: 人类几千年前就开始<w>驯化</w>狼了。

examples.text: It is difficult to <w>domesticate</w> wild animals that are not used to human contact.

target_lang_translations.zh: 很难<w>驯化</w>那些不习惯与人类接触的野生动物。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 使野生动物或植物适应与人类共同生活。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指通过长期培育使野生生物适应人类环境。
侧重于对动物的饲养和驯服。

senses.sense_definition: To make someone or something more accustomed to a quiet, settled home life.

examples.text: He tried to <w>domesticate</w> his wild lifestyle after getting married.

target_lang_translations.zh: 结婚后，他试图让自己<w>习惯于</w>安稳的家庭生活。

examples.text: They are slowly <w>domesticating</w> each other by spending quiet evenings at home.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他们通过在家度过安静的夜晚，慢慢地让彼此<w>习惯于</w>居家生活。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 使某人或某事变得习惯于安静、稳定的家庭生活。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指改变生活方式以适应居家环境。

senses.sense_definition: To adapt a text or cultural product to fit the norms and expectations of a local culture.

examples.text: The translator chose to <w>domesticate</w> the novel to make it more accessible to local readers.

target_lang_translations.zh: 译者选择将这部小说<w>本土化</w>，以便当地读者更容易理解。

examples.text: Critics argued that the film was too heavily <w>domesticated</w> for the international market.

target_lang_translations.zh: 评论家认为这部电影为了国际市场被过度<w>本土化</w>了。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 调整文本或文化产品以符合当地文化的规范和期望。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指将外来事物调整为符合本地文化习惯。

senses.sense_definition: To make a legal document valid and enforceable in a different jurisdiction.

examples.text: The lawyer had to <w>domesticate</w> the foreign court order before it could be enforced here.

target_lang_translations.zh: 律师必须先将外国法院的命令<w>在本地生效</w>，然后才能在此地执行。

examples.text: You must <w>domesticate</w> the judgment in this state to collect the debt.

target_lang_translations.zh: 你必须将该判决<w>在本地生效</w>才能追讨债务。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 使法律文件在不同的司法管辖区内有效并可执行。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 法律术语，指将外地判决在本地法院登记以获得执行力。

senses.sense_definition: An animal or plant that has been adapted to live with humans.

examples.text: The farm is home to many different <w>domesticates</w> including cows and sheep.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这个农场里养着许多不同的<w>驯化生物</w>，包括牛和羊。

examples.text: Researchers study the genetic history of various <w>domesticates</w> to understand human migration.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员通过研究各种<w>驯化生物</w>的遗传史来了解人类的迁徙。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 已适应与人类共同生活的动物或植物。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指经过人类长期驯化后的动植物。
